info.name: DAtuviSezaH
info.value: asmAt DAtoH  kamerRiN 3.1.30 ityanena svArTe 'RiN' pratyayaH Bavati . ArDaDAtukapratyayavivakzAyAM AyAdayaH ArDaDAtuke vA 3.1.31 ityanena ayam RiN pratyayaH vikalpyate .

info.name: anubanDaviSezaH
info.value: 1.934 janIjFzknasuraYjo'mantASca gaRasUtreRa asya DAtoH amantattvAt mittve prApte, 1.937 na kamyamicamAm ityanena tat niziDyate . ataH ayaM DAtuH mit nAsti .

info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to love,to desire, to long for, to have intercourse with

examples: 'na BABUpUkamigamipyAyivepAm' (pA॰8.4.34) iti sUtre prakamanam iti kASikAyAmudAharaRam. tadidaM prapUrvo'sya prayogo vyavahAraM nAtipatatIti vedayati.
'jyAyo BAgaDeyaM nikAmayamAnaH' (tE0 saM0 1.5.2.2). nikAmayamAno'BIcCan. mADyandinaM vA eza (somaH).
'nikAme nikAme naH parjanyo varzatu' (vA0 saM0 22.22). yadA yadAsmABiH kAmyeta tadA tadetyuktaM Bavati.
'teByo gAyatrIva vasuByo deveBya ekEkenAkzareRa kAmAn nikAmAn duhe' (jE0 brA0 1.30). niScitaH kAmo nikAmaH.
'na ca kAmasampadamaBikAmayate' (ki0 18.23). aBikAmayate kAmayate prArTayate. aBirDAtvarTaM na viSinazwi.

examples.text: ahaM va: kAmaye sarvA BAryA mama BavizyaTa
